page.notes: Marginal notes are partly in Greek (χαρίστικῶν, "ιν-" / "e-" fragments) and printed partly as "Materiae ιν-" with a Greek word; the Greek in the right margin is transcribed as printed but is uncertain. Right-margin note "Imitationis exemplum." sits beside the paragraph starting "Nos exercitij". The pagination "149" is printed at top right of the page. The signature "k 3" is printed at the foot of the text; treated as a gathering mark. The line "Autευχῇ" and "Aut ἐυχῇ" Greek word is uncertain. Left and right margin notes are small and some are in italic; the Greek note near "e-" may be imperfect. Catchword "Partes" is taken from the last line.
